cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Make the Choice Rewrite the Past
cards.instruction: Make them choose between options whose consequences reinterpret an earlier promise, refusal, or agreement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Keep my spare key or return it. Either choice explains last week's 'take some space.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then keeping it can mean the evening ended.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Would make that evening the beginning of something neither of us named.
